# Data Firehose

Buffer direct or Kinesis records and deliver them to S3.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `firehose` |
| Signing name | `firehose` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2015-08-04` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 12 of 12 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#data-firehose) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Only S3 destinations are implemented.
- No HTTP, Redshift, OpenSearch, Splunk, Snowflake or Iceberg destinations.
- No MSK/database sources, dynamic partitioning, format conversion, encryption or S3 backup behavior.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
